item.title: End-to-End Kubernetes E-Commerce Project
item.description: Automated CI/CD for a 3-Tier App using Jenkins, EKS, and ArgoCD.

item.title: Advanced Cloud & GitOps Implementations
item.description: This portfolio showcases recent hands-on projects, including a GitOps deployment pipeline on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with ArgoCD, a fully Terraform-codified AWS serverless CI/CD architecture, and an EKS-based three-tier e-commerce platform integrating Jenkins and ArgoCD.

item.title: Building a GitOps Microservices Architecture on AWS
item.description: This project details the implementation of an end-to-end DevOps Microservices architecture on AWS, leveraging a GitOps workflow with Terraform, AWS EKS, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD. It highlights key challenges encountered during deployment and their practical solutions.
